data.name: Maroof
data.gender_notes: Maroof is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who is close and trusted, a companion, a friend. The name Maroof carries the meaning “Friend” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maroof usually hope their child will grow to embody friend and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A person who guides others to the right path, a helper in the way of Allah.
data.etymology: Maroof belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Friend.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maroof total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: مَرُوف
in_arabic.long_meaning: مَرُوف: المَرُوفُ مِنَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ، وَمِنَ الأَصَحُّ فِي النَّسَبِ وَالتَصَحيفِ مَرُوفُ بْنُ حَيّانَ، مَرُوفُ بْنُ مَعَضٍ، وَهُوَ الَّذِي يَرجو مِنَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ مِنَ الرِزقِ مَرُوفً، وَهُوَ الشَيءُ الَّذِي يُعَرَّفُ بِهِ الرِجالُ، وَهُوَ الحِبيبُ الصَالِحُ مِنَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ، وَهُوَ مَن يُجِدُهُ الرِجالُ مِنَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ، وَهُوَ مَن يَخافُهُ الرِجالُ مِنَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ، وَهُوَ مَن يُثني عَلَيْهِ الرِجالُ مِنَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ، وَهُوَ مَن يُحِبُّهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ، وَهُوَ مَن يُحِبُّهُ الرِجالُ مِنَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ، وَهُوَ مَن يُحِبُّهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ وَالرِجالُ، وَهُوَ مَن يُخافُهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ وَالرِجالُ، وَهُوَ مَن يُقيمُهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ وَالرِجالُ، وَهُوَ مُقيمٌ بِعَظيمِ مَحَبَّةٍ وَرِضًى مِنَ اللَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ وَالرِجالِ، وَمِنَ الأَحَبَّ لِلَّهِ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ وَلِلرِجالِ، وَمِنَ الأَحَبَّ لَهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ وَلِلرِجالِ، وَهُوَ الشَيءُ الَّذِي يُحِبُهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ وَالرِجالُ، وَهُوَ الشَيءُ الَّذِي يُخافُهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ وَالرِجالُ، وَهُوَ الشَيءُ الَّذِي يُقيمُهُ اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ وَالرِجالُ

in_english.name: Maroof
in_english.meaning: A person of good character, who is loved by Allah and is worthy of respect and admiration
in_english.long_meaning: Maroof is an Arabic name that means a person of good character, who is loved by Allah and is worthy of respect and admiration. The name Maroof comes from the Arabic root 'marifa', which means 'knowledge' or 'understanding'. In Islamic tradition, Maroof refers to a person who is knowledgeable and wise, and who has a deep understanding of Allah's laws and principles. Maroof is also a name that is associated with the concept of 'maroof', which means 'that which is known' or 'that which is recognized'. In this sense, Maroof refers to a person who is recognized and respected by others for their good character and their adherence to Allah's laws and principles.
